title: Geometry-Preserving Neural Architectures on Manifolds with Boundary
summary: A growing number of neural architectures have been proposed to enforce geometric constraints, including projection-based networks, exponential-map updates, constrained output layers, and manifold neural ODEs. We provide a unified framework for these geometry-preserving architectures by organizing them according to where and how constraints are enforced, either throughout the intermediate layers or only at the final output.
